concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-user-manuals-terminal-deprecation-vx690-user-manual-perform-a-refund-vx690]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured historical VX690 standalone refund guide with per-device enablement, password/PIN wording and unsynchronized-data warning; it gives no completed-refund proof and is bounded by the 29 March 2024 eVo transaction cutoff.
warnings: The raw separately calls for a password and a device-unlock PIN without defining their relationship; do not equate them. The exclamation warning means unsynchronized data, not a refund outcome.
